Increasing issues make for a lousy experience.. I should preface by saying I use Uber a lot, and I have for years. I have preferred it over other ride-app services. However, increasing issues make it hard to stand by Uber, and as of recent I have had many more bad experiences than good. For one, ETA estimations before booking have been underestimating with increasing severity. Recently I have  (regretfully) had to double their estimation when planning, and even this no longer works now. Secondly, the tipping prompt always comes up as I’m trying to book my next trip, which is both inefficient and frustrating. “Hey, remember that last trip you went on last week? Want to tip now?” By the time I get the prompt, tipping feels more out of force than generosity. Thirdly, trip cancelations have been a massive issue. Many times I have been canceled on after 10 minutes of waiting. With these issues, the Uber experience seems to be on the decline. I will be trying Lyft to see if this is a ride-share app issue or Uber specific issue.
